english_title: 29. His Supplication when his Provision was Stinted

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ ابْتَلَيْتَنَا فِي أَرْزَاقِنَا بِسُوءِ الظَّنِّ
phrases.english: 1.O God, You hast tried us with distrust in our provisions

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى الْتَمَسْنَا أَرْزَاقَكَ  مِنْ عِنْدِ الْمَرْزُوقِينَ،
phrases.english: 3.until we begged for provisions from those who are provided
4.and craved in our expectations the life-spans of the long-lived!

phrases.arabic: وَهَبْ  لَنَا يَقِيناً صَادِقاً تَكْفِينا بِهِ مِنْ مَؤونَةِ الطَّلَبِ،
phrases.english: 6.give us a true certainty that will suffice us the burden of seeking,

phrases.arabic: وَأَلْهِمْنَا ثِقَةً خَالِصَةً تُعْفِينَا بِهَا مِنْ شِدَّةِ  النَّصَبِ،
phrases.english: 7.and inspire us with a sincere trust that will release us from the hardship of exertion!

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ مَا صَرَّحتَ بِهِ مِنْ عِدَتِكَ فِي وَحْيِكَ،
phrases.english: 8.Let Your clear promise in Your Revelation
9.which You hast followed in Your Book with Your oath

phrases.arabic: قَاطِعاً لاهْتِمَامِنَا بِالرِّزْقِ الَّـذِيْ تَكَفَّلْتَ بِهِ
phrases.english: 10.cut off our worry about the provision for which You hast made Yourself responsible

phrases.arabic: وَحَسْمَاً لِلاشْتِغَالِ بِمَا ضَمِنْتَ الْكِفَايَةَ لَهُ،
phrases.english: 11.and sever our occupation with everything whose sufficiency You hast guaranteed!
12.For You hast said - and Your word is the most truthful truth
13.and You hast sworn - and Your oath is the most kept and fulfilled
14."In the heaven are your provision and everything you are promised" (51:22)!

phrases.arabic: ثُمَّ  قُلْتَ: ( فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ إنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِثْلَ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُوْنَ ).
phrases.english: 15.And then You hast said, "So by the Lord of heaven and earth, it is as surely true as that you have speech" (51:23)!
